title: Comparative religion
learning_outcomes: Explain descriptive and normative claims in the context of comparative religion.
Compare and distinguish traditions and diversity in the context of comparative religion.
Apply source evaluation in the context of comparative religion.
Evaluate and justify decisions about coexistence in the context of comparative religion.

lessons.title: Descriptive and normative claims
lessons.outcome: Explain descriptive and normative claims in the context of comparative religion.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving descriptive and normative claims; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to religion case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain descriptive and normative claims from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of descriptive and normative claims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Traditions and diversity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish traditions and diversity in the context of comparative religion.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving traditions and diversity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to religion case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain traditions and diversity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of traditions and diversity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Source evaluation
lessons.outcome: Apply source evaluation in the context of comparative religion.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving source evaluation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to religion case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain source evaluation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of source evaluation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Coexistence
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about coexistence in the context of comparative religion.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coexistence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to religion case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coexistence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coexistence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of descriptive and normative claims; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of traditions and diversity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of source evaluation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of coexistence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
